walkthroughs.body_html:
This topic is part of the Edexcel GCSE Geography specification.

The Changing Landscapes of the UK appears in the assessment, so it's worth knowing well.

You'll meet The Changing Landscapes of the UK in exam questions and need to apply your knowledge.

The Edexcel board expects you to understand both the concepts and how to use them.

Use the activities in this adventure to build familiarity with The Changing Landscapes of the UK.

Practise vocabulary, calculations and free-text questions to lock in the learning.
